# directus_relation (Resource)

Manages a Directus relation between collections (directus_relations + the underlying foreign key).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `collection` (String) The 'many' collection that holds the relational field. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `field` (String) The relational field on the collection. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `meta` (Attributes) Directus relation metadata (directus_relations). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--meta))
- `related_collection` (String) The 'one' collection this relation points to.
- `schema` (Attributes) Underlying database foreign-key constraint. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schema))

<a id="nestedatt--meta"></a>
### Nested Schema for `meta`

Optional:

- `junction_field` (String) Junction field for m2m relations.
- `many_collection` (String) The 'many' collection name.
- `many_field` (String) The 'many' side field name.
- `one_allowed_collections` (List of String) Allowed collections for m2a relations.
- `one_collection` (String) The 'one' collection name.
- `one_collection_field` (String) The 'one' collection field for m2a relations.
- `one_deselect_action` (String) Action on deselect (nullify or delete).
- `one_field` (String) The 'one' side field name (reverse alias).
- `sort_field` (String) Field used to sort related items.


<a id="nestedatt--schema"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schema`

Optional:

- `column` (String) Local column backing the relation.
- `constraint_name` (String) Foreign-key constraint name.
- `foreign_key_column` (String) Referenced column.
- `foreign_key_schema` (String) Referenced schema.
- `foreign_key_table` (String) Referenced table.
- `on_delete` (String) ON DELETE behavior (e.g. SET NULL, CASCADE).
- `on_update` (String) ON UPDATE behavior.
- `table` (String) Local table backing the relation.
